sloka: रथेन तु खरो वेगात् सैन्यस्य अग्रात् विनिःसृतः ।श्येनगामी पृथुग्रीवो यज्ञशत्रुः विहंगमः ॥३-२३-३१॥
transliteration: rathena tu kharo vegāt sainyasya agrāt viniḥsṛtaḥ ।śyenagāmī pṛthugrīvo yajñaśatruḥ vihaṁgamaḥ ॥3-23-31॥

translations.english: Seeing Khara, their chief on the chariot driving fast, the army of demons too marched forward.
